crossRefs.note: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden…
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…
You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are…
For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we…
neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that…

translations.web: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
translations.bsb: I have seen the burden that God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them.
translations.kjv: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised
translations.asv: I have seen the travail which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.
